prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In Deferred to Post-Waiting Step: Moves the sign-in step to occur immediately after pet generation on the waiting screen, right before entering the desktop intro.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "sign_in", "home_intro"]}
1: [home, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Playroom Minigame: Adds interactive companion toy animation controls on the waiting screen while pet generation completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Play while your pet gets ready!", "components": [{"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:toy_playroom", "style": "playful", "action": "play"}]}}
2: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Controls Practice Screen: Adds a new screen (new_desktop_practice) before final setup where users test moving, summoning, and toggling their companion.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "new_desktop_practice", "home_intro"], "new_desktop_practice": {"headline": "Practice Desktop Companion Controls", "body": "Try right-clicking to open settings, dragging your pet, and toggling companion visibility.", "button_label": "Got It, Launch Pet!", "layout": "centered"}}
3: [sign_in, copy] Adoption Certificate Account Preservation Banner: Updates sign-in copy to explicitly inform users that signing in prevents pet data reset and loss upon logging back in.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Save & Protect Your Companion Account", "body": "Signing in links your pet securely to your account so you never lose your companion when switching devices or logging in later."}}
4: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Adoption Stage Redesign: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen layout to a visual stage layout with highlighted protection badges.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Official Companion Adoption", "body": "Your companion is officially registered to your account.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Account Protected", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
5: [home, wait_info] Interactive Waiting Progress Countdown: Displays live progress and estimated time indicators on the waiting screen during pet rendering.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Workspace", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "show_step_counter": true}}
6: [finish, copy] Clear Desktop Launch Call to Action: Updates the final launch CTA button copy on home_intro to explicitly action 'Launch Pet onto Desktop Now'.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "body": "Click below to summon your pet directly onto your desktop screen.", "button_label": "Launch Pet onto Desktop Now"}}
7: [choose_path, new_flow] Story Scroll Path Selector Experience: Changes path selection screen layout to story_scroll to create an immersive story narrative during path selection.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Select Your Companion's Journey", "body": "Choose how you want your desktop companion to assist and play on your screen."}}
8: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Dock Position Selection Screen: Adds a new screen (new_dock_setup) allowing users to pick their pet's initial desktop placement (Taskbar, Corner, Center).
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "new_dock_setup", "home_intro"], "new_dock_setup": {"headline": "Choose Desktop Companion Home Spot", "body": "Select where your companion should hang out on your screen.", "layout": "grid", "button_label": "Confirm Location"}}
9: [sign_in, notification] Account Sign-In Safeguard Highlight Notice: Adds a visual highlight badge on the sign-in screen emphasizing cloud sync and data preservation.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Secure Your Pet Across Devices", "body": "Log into your account to keep your companion safe and synced across your desktop machines.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Sync & Account Backup Enabled", "style": "highlight"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign-in step after waiting is explicitly allowed by rule 4.
Adding interactive components to the waiting screen is allowed inside onboarding.
Adding a new practice screen inside onboarding before home intro is allowed.
Updating sign-in copy to highlight account preservation is allowed.
Removes the official stamp required on the adoption certificate screen.
Live progress indicators during a real waiting screen are permitted.
Updating CTA button copy on home_intro is allowed.
Fails to offer both adopting and making your own on the choose path screen.
Adding a new setup screen before home intro is permitted under rule 4.
Adding account backup visual components to the sign-in screen is allowed.
